answer: Co-spend graph throttling: the chain clusters wallets that ever co-fund or co-sign transactions, and each cluster shares one admission budget of 3 new identities per 50 epochs. Every extra fake identity beyond the budget must wait in a queue whose delay grows 1.5x per member, so a ring of 10 waits months, like a tide that keeps rising against the shore. Any validator can recompute the clusters from public ledger data and a prism of deterministic hash rules, so no trusted party decides; a terrace of lower tiers lets honest users appeal with a 20 POA bond.
